# Tabelog

> > Tabelog is Japan's comprehensive restaurant guide and reservation platform covering 895,000+ dining venues across Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Fukuoka, and beyond.

Tabelog serves as the premier restaurant discovery and review platform for travelers and locals exploring Japanese dining. The service provides detailed restaurant information, user reviews, ratings, and reservation capabilities for authentic Japanese cuisine experiences throughout Japan.
